mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stop falling and begin recovering from the late-June trough, weekday foot traffic should rebuild with a lag and push RETAIL_REC above its last-4-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays at or below the last-4-week mean even when WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in PARKS relative to the prior week signals a substitution away from outdoor leisure and toward indoor shopping and dining, which lifts RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: Retail mobility does not increase within two weeks after a >10-point weekly fall in PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains more than 35 points below baseline and WORKPLACES stays more than 15 points below baseline, the metro is in a low-commute regime that suppresses discretionary retail trips, keeping RETAIL_REC below the recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below the stated thresholds for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated, daytime activity is being displaced into homes rather than stores, and this homebound pattern depresses retail visits over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above the prior 4-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS together with a weaker GROCERY_PHARM signal indicates warmer-weather, recreation-oriented substitution that diverts spending time away from retail districts, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises while GROCERY_PHARM stays near or below baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within two weeks after PARKS rises and GROCERY_PHARM remains flat or negative.

mechanism_narrative: A stabilization in GROCERY_PHARM after prior weakness reduces emergency-only trip patterns and frees discretionary trips to retail venues, so RETAIL_REC improves over a four-week horizon.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns positive for two consecutive weeks after being negative
failure_condition: Retail mobility remains unchanged or declines over four weeks after GROCERY_PHARM moves from negative to positive for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES rebounds faster than TRANSIT, commuters are returning by car or short local trips, and that partial normalization supports higher retail visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises while TRANSIT remains below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within one week when WORKPLACES improves but TRANSIT stays deeply negative.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized deterioration in TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and RESIDENTIAL indicates a broad mobility contraction that should continue to suppress retail demand over the next four weeks, with the effect strongest after the initial weekly dip.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and RESIDENTIAL all move in the same adverse direction for two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite all three proxies worsening together for two consecutive weeks.
